observed_order.observation: Re-extracts the exact item and checks validated capability equality; applies note effects, then ordinary-context volume nullifier and payload. Direct function can return an error after writes to its supplied StateWrite; transaction-level rollback requires the caller delta.

Begins an exclusive state transaction, runs execution and mode-specific index work, then applies delta; only afterwards pushes a DeferredBatch queue entry. Errors before apply drop the transaction. This supports a caller-level delta model, not a theorem that each low-level action independently rolls back.

Arc::get_mut guards exclusive parent access. A new delta owns cached changes; apply flattens them and applies to the parent. This source read has not established a formal Rust ownership/cache or durable storage refinement.

Begins separate transaction, obtains height, drains queue with mem::take before fallible put_block_transaction calls; applies index delta only after all writes. Failure after drain can preserve pending effects and lose the queue; TransferIndexing explicitly models that behavior.
Flush failure is handled by expect/panic before component end-block hooks. Consumer abort/recovery discipline and durable writer behavior remain separate obligations.

model_assessment: Current TransferIndexing/TransferTransaction comments correctly avoid claiming native durability or unconditional restoration of the deferred queue. No runtime change proposed from this read alone. G5 needs exact caller/store refinement and supported fault-injection evidence.
